text:
sam: support case — onboarding webhook fired twice after a 429 during token refresh. small set of users but high severity for billing webhooks.
anya: can we see a sanitized trace?
sam: paste:
```
2026-03-22T22:03:11Z req=hj12 status=429 retry-after=0.2
2026-03-22T22:03:11Z sdk retried req=hj12 idempotency=none
2026-03-22T22:03:12Z server delivered webhook idempotency=none
```
leo: looks like immediate replay on refresh. ideas: (A) sample apps should auto-add an Idempotency-Key for mutating calls (opt-out). (B) introduce a short-lived server-side nonce header `X-Rw-Replay-Nonce` that SDKs can send when retrying during auth refresh; servers check-and-dedup nonces within a TTL (30s) without touching payloads. (C) low-cardinality sampling header for infra to correlate events.
anya: explain nonce flow quickly?
leo: sketch: on initial attempt SDK sends no nonce. if auth refresh + retry occurs, SDK includes `X-Rw-Replay-Nonce: <short-uuid>` and header `X-Rw-Replay-Reason: auth-refresh`. server keeps seen-nonces for 30s and rejects duplicate nonces for mutating endpoints. nonce storage is boolean only, no payload kept.
sam: nice. that avoids always attaching idempotency keys for streams. plus still recommend Idempotency-Key on sample apps.
anya: sampling header name idea: `X-Rw-Replay-Sample: 0.005` (probability) plus short tag `X-Rw-Sample-Info: v1;sdk=go;tag=replay-debug` sent only when sampling decides yes. infra will only index boolean + short tag.
leo: SDK parity: Node/Py/Go should expose opts {autoIdempotency: boolean, replayNonceTtlSec: number, replaySampleRate: float, honorRetryAfter: boolean}. sample apps should show the flags. streaming endpoints explicit opt-in for nonces; default off for streams.
anya: pseudocode for SDK resend during refresh:
```js
if (duringTokenRefresh) {
  headers['X-Rw-Replay-Nonce'] = generateShortUuid()
  headers['X-Rw-Replay-Reason'] = 'auth-refresh'
  if (sampleDecide()) headers['X-Rw-Replay-Sample'] = '1'; headers['X-Rw-Sample-Info'] = 'v1;sdk=node;tag=replay'
}
await retryWithExpJitter({base:200, max:30000, honorRetryAfter:true})
```
sam: infra question: can runtime index a boolean for `X-Rw-Replay-Sample` pre-scrub? we only need short-lived correlation.
infra: yes, we can capture a short boolean + tag and keep for 7 days. must be explicit in RFC about no PII.
leo: action items: 1) devex draft RFC proposing nonce + sample headers + SDK defaults (assignee: @leo). 2) infra to support `X-Rw-Replay-Nonce` TTL dedupe and accept `X-Rw-Replay-Sample` boolean (assignee: @infra). 3) SDK teams: add parity flags and update sample apps (owners: SDK leads). 4) docs/devrel: add streaming exceptions and onboarding note.
ci-bot: created issue devex-1177: "replay-nonce + sample telemetry RFC" (assignee: @leo) :spiral_note_pad:
anya: also add a small metric `throttle_replay_count` so ops can monitor regression.
sam: and compatibility: servers treat absent nonce/header as legacy behavior (no guarantees). RFC should include upgrade plan for older SDKs.
leo: i'll draft RFC tonight and link. thanks all. :thumbsup:
